cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't leave the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lift them both. You only have to read how much bigger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Check the zero yourself, then read the dial while I lift. Give me one minute.

reason: Reread found choosing scales both unestablished and weak against B departure pressure. Use the existing weighing instrument, give B calibration control, and ask for a bounded minute.
